statusOfflineGuidance.message: Check that the daemon is running (systemctl status webhid-daemon), that your user is in the webhid group, and that the udev rules are installed.

macPrivacyDesc.message: Allow the daemon to read HID devices: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. If the link does not open the right tab, find it manually and enable the daemon.

settingsDaemonAsNmHostDesc.message: Talk to the daemon directly over native messaging, skipping the forwarder and Unix socket. Requires the daemon_nm_host manifest and the daemon running as your user (with the udev rule). Lower latency, no root-daemon fallback. Reconnects automatically.

settingsDataPlaneDesc.message:
**WebTransport** (default): the fastest option; runs in a background worker so pages stay smooth.
**WebTransport (in-page)**: connects directly in the page; fine at normal report rates, uses more page CPU. Use it when the site blocks background workers (CSP) but still allows the connection; the worker-based options would fall back to Native Messaging there. Firefox asks a one-time local-network permission ("Allow") before the first in-page connection; tick "Remember my choice for this site". Reload pages after changing.
**WebSocket**: fallback when WebTransport is not available (older Firefox).
**Native Messaging**: the slowest but most compatible option; use when a site's security policy blocks the others.

settingsDevicePickerModeDesc.message:
**Modal**: shadow-DOM overlay on the page when requestDevice() is called (default).
**Page Action**: URL-bar popup picker; the user clicks the icon to open it. Firefox only, Chromium falls back to modal.
**Window**: separate popup window.

settingsWorkerPolyfillDesc.message: Injects the full WebHID API into Worker scripts (new Worker()). requestDevice() stays page-only, as the spec requires. Reload pages after changing.

settingsAllowActivationlessDesc.message: Skip the user-activation requirement for requestDevice() on this site. Spec deviation; workaround for sites that call it from an async handler. The chooser still requires explicit user selection. Reload pages after changing.

settingsLogLevelDesc.message: Console verbosity: Error = errors only, Warn = +warnings, Info = +info, Debug = +debug (includes timing). Reload pages after changing.

settingsWorkerSpawnModeDesc.message:
**Shadow URL** (default on MV3): spawns the data worker via new Worker(location.href) with a StreamFilter intercepting the synthetic self-request; respects the page's security settings and changes nothing about the page. Fails if the server rejects it or if require-trusted-types-for is restrictive.
**Blob + CSP rewrite** (default on MV2): spawns the worker from a blob: URL; relaxes the page's worker-src and connect-src directives. Works fully on MV2; on MV3 only a meta-tag CSP can be rewritten, so header-based policies still block it.
